sanskrit:
इति गुह्यतमं शास्त्रमिदमुक्तं मयानघ।
एतद्बुद्ध्वा बुद्धिमान्स्यात्कृतकृत्यश्च भारत।।
caption:
Chapter 15, Verse 20

Kṛṣṇa concludes the chapter. ‘iti guhyatamaṁ śāstram’ (This is the most confidential part of the Vedic scriptures). ‘idam uktaṁ mayānagha’ (O sinless one, it is disclosed now by Me). ‘etad buddhvā buddhimān syāt’ (Whoever understands this will become wise). ‘kṛta-kṛtyaś ca bhārata’ (And his endeavors will know perfection). Kṛṣṇa calls this chapter ‘Guhyatamam’ (Most Confidential) because it succinctly distinguishes the Jīva from the Lord and establishes Bhakti as the function of the wise. Knowing this makes one ‘Krita-kritya’ (perfect/successful).
